title: Elon's new car steers with buttons instead of a wheel

This is how Tesla first showed a car built to drive completely alone
caption:
At Tesla's We, Robot event in October 2024, Elon Musk showed the Cybercab for the first time: a two-seater with no steering wheel and no pedals, built entirely for a world where the car drives you.

Most people assumed full autonomy was still years away from being real. Tesla drove one onto a stage in front of a live audience.

Cybercabs are already running in Austin and Tampa today. This is the moment it started.
